help.rating: The star rating (1-10) reflects how well a recipe aligns with established dietary guidelines. A higher score means the overall balance of ingredients is more in line with recommended nutritional standards. Our AI's suggestions are designed to help you tweak your recipes to achieve a higher rating and improve the overall nutritional balance of your meal.

acceptance.heading: 1. Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.body: These Terms and Conditions ("Terms") govern your use of the MyRecipeWatch mobile application ("the App"), developed by the Institute of Communication and Computer Systems (ICCS) as part of the EU-funded DietWise project. By installing, accessing, or using the App, you agree to be bound by these Terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the App.

service.heading: 2. About the Service
service.body: MyRecipeWatch is a research application that evaluates online recipes against national nutritional guidelines and proposes alternative ingredients. Suggestions are generated by automated systems and are informational only. The App is provided as part of an ongoing research project and its features may change, be paused, or be discontinued without notice.

eligibility.heading: 3. Eligibility
eligibility.body: You must be at least 18 years old, or have the consent of a parent or legal guardian, to use the App.

account.heading: 4. Account Registration
account.body: Certain features require an account, authenticated via the DietWise identity service. You are responsible for keeping your credentials confidential and for all activity that occurs under your account. Notify the project team promptly of any suspected unauthorized use.

acceptableUse.heading: 5. Acceptable Use
acceptableUse.body: You agree to use the App only for personal, non-commercial purposes and in compliance with applicable law. You must not: (a) attempt to disrupt or compromise the security of the App or its backend services; (b) use the App to harvest, mine, or otherwise extract data at scale; (c) misrepresent your identity; or (d) submit content that is unlawful, offensive, or infringes the rights of others.

userContent.heading: 6. User-Provided Content and Feedback
userContent.body: When you submit recipe URLs, personal information, or feedback (such as acceptance or rejection of suggestions), you grant the project a non-exclusive, royalty-free license to use this data — in anonymized or aggregated form where applicable — for the purposes of operating, evaluating, and improving the service and for research outputs related to the DietWise project. They are not medical, dietary, or nutritional advice and are not a substitute for professional consultation. Consult a qualified healthcare provider before making significant changes to your diet, especially if you have a medical condition, allergies, or dietary restrictions.
